## Problem and resulting behavior

Describe the concrete problem and what changes for the operator. Link the issue or primary advisory if relevant.

## Evidence

Include the fixture, source or before/after result that supports the change. For a verdict change, explain its effect on uncertainty and Go/browser parity.

## Validation

List the commands you ran and their results. Name any required check that was not run and why.

## Compatibility

Call out changes to CLI flags, exit codes, JSON schemas, platform support or dependencies. Write “None” if there are none.
